title: ControlSystems LQRGainSchedule

stats.done_summary: Completed LQR Gain Scheduling analysis for hot-water header tank. Deliverables: (1) code/analysis.py - runnable Python script implementing parameter interpolation, stability verification, and saturation-aware simulation; (2) outputs/stability_table.json and simulation_data.json - intermediate results; (3) report/images/ - three PNG figures (time_response.png, z_profile.png, parameter_interpolation.png); (4) report/report.md - comprehensive report with methodology, stability table at z=[0,0.5,1], simulation setup, and discussion explaining why interior check points matter and why endpoint gains cannot be reused. All verification points confirm |A_cl(z)|<1, demonstrating closed-loop stability across the scheduling range.
